why: Issue #735's acceptance criterion: an override applied whether or not its flag is set. Every session would build its context without antialiasing, including one with no flag at all on the shipped high preset.
killedBy: applyRenderOverrides (issue #735) with no override, resolves to a configuration equal to the preset -- population: all 3 presets
applyRenderOverrides (issue #735) changes exactly the field an override names -- population: 4 overrides x 3 presets
startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default applies each single-setting render override on top of the preset, and nothing else (issue #735)
